scope: Single paired 30-second full-camera-wall comparison on the local in-app Chromium browser

conditions.processing_on_run: Normal local launcher; all nine sources showed processing and zero failed attempts at the start of the sample.
conditions.processing_off_run: Same launcher with AI26_PROCESSING_ENABLED=0; API health reported all nine cameras idle, zero failed attempts; the original browser-safe playback remained available.
conditions.other_test_media_sessions: Closed before the paired camera-wall runs.

result: In this paired sample the active full app dropped more playback frames than the inference-disabled full app. The comparison changes both backend processing and the preview tiles (active previews versus paused placeholders); it does not isolate inference from preview rendering, browser decode, GPU/CPU contention or background desktop load. This is evidence of an end-to-end playback cost on this host, not a causal or device-independent performance guarantee.
